note: The live database currently contains 150 stock profiles, newer than the older v0.8 JSON snapshot. This manifest records the live curated image assignment layer.
policy: Match subject and mood to the location's archetype, departments, modelling note, visual family and setting.
Do not repeat the same photograph within a district.
Use deterministic pool hashing only as a fallback if an explicit assignment is absent.
